about: Where geometer.dev's Journal pieces went: the six community and livelihood pieces moved to the Streetlist Journal on 14 Nov 2026. Each entry is a permanent (301) redirect in Firebase Hosting's own shape (source on geometer.dev, destination here), for the geometer.dev website job to copy into its firebase.json. The technical pieces are not here: they move to docs.geometer.dev/notes in another job. While the six pieces are stashed as drafts (15 Nov 2026) every destination is the front page, https://journal.streetlist.in/; a piece brought back gets its own address again. tests/site.test.ts checks that every destination is a page this site builds.
